description: Runtime field contract, not a JSON Schema validator. Synthetic fixtures use these shapes too.

snapshot.unknowns: CPU, memory, capacity, uptime, load, and pressure values can be null. Never coerce unknown to zero.
snapshot.processes: At most 20 by RSS from at most 2,000 PIDs. pid, ppid, name, state, rss bytes, cpu_percent per logical core.
snapshot.capacity: percent = used / (used + space available to an ordinary user), root mount only

job.bounds: Eight seconds and 12,000 retained output bytes per fixed command; capped output is limited evidence. Latest job only.

report.samples: Up to 200 browser-session samples: sequence, collected_at, cpu, memory. Reload clears samples.
report.coverage: Rows of title, assessment, explanation. Unrun, inaccessible, and excluded areas remain limited.
